scientific_integrity: A full mathematical proof and a reproducible finite exact-arithmetic consistency check accompany the claim. The finite check is not used as the infinite proof. Published source claims and newly proved results are distinguished.
scientific_limitations: The exact endpoint beta=1/3 is not proved; this is an almost-sure theorem for idealized iid Cohen–Lenstra draws and not a theorem for actual number-field class groups. Independent bibliographic and mathematical validation are outstanding.
title: One-third Orlicz threshold for simultaneous Cohen–Lenstra strong laws
